note: Initial checkpoint. Scope: snapshots/s03 only. Invariant: any user-memory field (length/count/pointer/union member) fetched from user memory more than once (get_user/copy_from_user/peek) such that one fetch feeds validation and a distinct fetch feeds use; validated copy must be bit-identical to used copy. Plan: automated double-fetch scanner (functions containing >=2 fetch-family calls referencing the same user pointer/macro), then deep-read top candidates incl. known historical double-fetch sites (perf/ioctl, keyctl, pcbit, msgrcv union, netlink, compat).
